research: Reviewed what B004-B013 (Hobo Bag) already did: angles n_things, demo, stop_x, travel, value and the day story, and their hooks ('Four things you'll notice', 'Stop digging for your keys', 'Watch what this bag does...', 'Ever pat your bag...', 'Half price, plus a free matching pouch wallet'): none of the four stories below repeats an angle, a hook or a line.

Read the owner's feedback (Julian): b-roll must match the words, no review chapters, better end cards, videos that look alike: so each project has a different structure (pack-out demo, crowd scenario, gift guide, numbered buyer's guide) and every line names the picture it needs.

Research (docs/research/2026-10-black-friday-and-bag-ads.md): BFCM statics win with one big visual and one offer line; pack-for-a-scenario demos (Dagne Dover, Bellroy), 'locks to furniture' / feature pointouts (Pacsafe), numbered '5 reasons' (Bellroy), gifting (Fossil), 'don't buy yet' hooks: used for P01, P02, P04, P03.

Static concepts from the same research: flat-lay 'what fits', café chair with props, pocket close-up, gift styling, dark luxe Black Friday hero, entryway; at least half of the statics are AI studio scenes of the real bag with room left for the words.

Compliance: only the offer's facts (50% off, free matching pouch wallet, free US shipping, one-year warranty, easy returns, 'anti-theft'), no countdown or sale end date, no 'theft-proof', no first person, no review chapters in the videos.

projects.why_new: Earlier batches talked features in a list (n_things / demo / stop / travel) or walked a day. This is a visual packing sequence where every line is an item going into a place, ending on the free pouch wallet: a different structure and a different picture for every line.

Now the sides. There's a gold zip on each side, made for your keys and your phone. Reach in, grab, zip. No digging.
Turn it around. A hidden pocket sits on the back, flat against you. That's where your passport and cards go, out of sight.
Then the pouch wallet. It's free, it matches your bag, and it holds the little things you want close.
All packed? Pick how you carry it. Two straps, so it goes on your shoulder, in your hand, or crossbody. Your hands stay free.
And the leather is soft, water-resistant and scratch-proof. It looks expensive, and it gets better the longer you own it.
Worried it won't suit you? A one-year warranty and easy returns have you covered.

chapters.text: Here's your checklist. Five things to check on any bag before you pay for it.
Where do your passport and cards sit? Look for a pocket against your body. The Hobo Bag has a hidden anti-theft pocket on the back, flat against you.
Can you reach your keys without opening the bag? Look for zips on the sides. The Hobo Bag has two gold side zips, one on each side, made for keys and phone.
Does it stay organised? Look inside. Divided compartments mean nothing sinks to the bottom, so you find what you need fast.
Can you wear it more than one way? Check the straps. Two adjustable straps give you shoulder, handbag or crossbody.
Will it keep looking good? Feel the leather. This one is soft, water-resistant and scratch-proof, and it only gets better with time.
The Hobo Bag passes every check. And if it's not for you, there's a one-year warranty and easy returns.
